Text: I can try scanning for anything suspicious.
What's that on the desk? Let's go take a look.
Strange. Lucia really doesn't remember anything about the movie?
I should meet her at Sequence Square first.
I should grab them and meet her at Sequence Square.
Perfect timing. I can still check out this week's magazine.
I'll fix up my outfit and go look for Lucia.
Message from Lucia. Please check promptly.
Better bring the origami clover. It might help prove the time loop.
The sky is completely clear. Is it really going to rain?
The clouds are actually rolling in... Let's move faster, Commandant.
(That scene just now... Deja vu...)
Looks like that's the end of the story. Shall we leave?
Let's find a seat. I wonder if there are any free tables up ahead...
Two origami clovers rest on the table, stacked one over the other.
What exactly were those things I saw today...?
No clue for now. I'd better get some rest.
Lucia doesn't seem like she's joking. She really doesn't remember what happened yesterday.
...Was the lounge like this before I went to bed last night?
The display flickers with a soft blue light, its interface cluttered with files. Some of them, you clearly remember deleting yesterday, but now they're back, right in front of you.
The time display shows yesterday's date. It shouldn't.
Everything in the lounge looks exactly like it did yesterday morning. Most notably, the trial vouchers on the table—you used two of them yesterday, yet now they're all neatly lined up again.
Everything here has gone back to how it was yesterday morning.
Except for...
Two origami clovers lie quietly on the table. You clearly remember there was only one here yesterday morning.
One of them was the one Lucia gave me earlier yesterday.
...Anyway, I should go meet up with Lucia now.
Lucia doesn't seem like she's joking. She really doesn't remember what happened yesterday.
...Was the lounge like this before I went to bed last night?
Perhaps scanning might reveal some overlooked clues...
I didn't expect these small changes to make such a big difference. Every time I saw myself in the mirror with a new hairstyle, I barely recognized the person looking back...
Just like you said, Commandant, trying new things really does lead to new experiences.
There's still a bit of time before dinner. How about heading to Kuroro Coffee next? I heard they have an interactive activity where you can brew your own coffee. Want to try it together?
Sure thing. The pro barista is on the way.
Everything's ready. Let's begin building the dream.
...S-sorry... bumped...
...Coffee... spilled on clothes...
Better bring the origami clover. It might help prove the time loop.
Are all those people... waiting for a table?
Let's go check it out.
Are you sure you don't want to think it over more? I mean, what if this isn't the right solution?
I'm prepared to face failure if I'm wrong. But if that choice ends up hurting you...
There's always risk in the unknown. I just don't want you to be the one who pays the price.
But facing the unknown together—that's always been our unspoken promise, hasn't it?
As long as it's a wish that truly comes from both our hearts, that's enough.
Trust yourself, and trust us, Lucia.
Alright, Commandant.
It's gone...
What's this?
(An origami clover, beautiful and delicate. The surface is smooth and unwrinkled. Each leaf is subtly raised, giving the clover a natural, three-dimensional look.)
Where did this clover come from?
Let's head back early and get some rest today!
Commandant, does anything look different from the last time you were here?
Doesn't seem like much has changed.
Is that Froggie up ahead? Something about it... looks weird.
Froggie is leaning over its backpack, rummaging around. Strangely, even with people nearby, it stays frozen in place, completely motionless.
The film isn't playing properly... could this be one of those data errors the staff mentioned?
He did say missing plot items are the most common issue. Let's scan the area. Maybe we'll find something.
I'm picking up on something, Commandant. Let's check it out.
A small bottle shimmers with a soft, warm glow. Inside, it's filled with clear dewdrops.
These look like Froggie's Wish Dewdrops. Could this be what we're missing?
It matches the scan results. Maybe returning it to Froggie will get the story moving again?
A big storm's coming. Gotta stash the Wish Dewdrops deep inside my backpack, ribbit.
After taking shelter from the rain, Froggie heads straight for the forest. The plot's mostly the same as last time.
Doesn't look like there's anything new here. Let's move on to the next scene.
(Froggie is bowing its head slightly, appearing to read, but its hands are completely empty.)
Looks like the same kind of error as before.
Let's scan the area.
I found something, Commandant.
(A piece of paper lies quietly on the ground. It lists several tree hollow locations. All but the last one have been crossed out.)
Here it is. This must be what we need.
This is the last tree hollow where the golden fireflies might be hiding...
Found them! Froggie's gonna catch you... gotcha!
Did anything change in the story this time, Commandant?
There were fewer little mishaps, but otherwise it played out the same. Nothing new here. Let's move on.
Looks like things went smoothly this time. The story's back on track.
A small, delicate origami clover with perfect folds.
A slightly rougher clover. Its leaves are uneven, but the folds are still neat.
A crooked origami clover with folds of uneven depth and slightly overlapping edges.
Are these all origami clovers?
So the wishes we made have turned into gift boxes here.
So now even more things are here to witness our vows?
You can never have too many good memories.
Come on. Our dream is just getting started.
I want to make you a gift. How about it?
As for what it is... I'll keep it a secret for now.
Please don't turn around just yet. Almost done...
Alright, your gift is on your head now.
Do you like it, Commandant?
I like it. Thank you, Lucia.
Now, it's my turn to give you a gift.
A gift... for me?
Just one moment.
Done.
Well?
Thank you, I really like it. And I just realized...
We share the same sentiment on a lot of things.
Whether it's about gifts... or other things.
The red light on top just started blinking.
Hurry, Commandant. This might be the last shot.
The fireworks, and this whole experience... are coming to a close.
About the loop, the wish, and what comes next...
Let's think about all that during our walk, Commandant.
Commandant...
Is that... a clock? The hands... they're moving in reverse.
Do you like it, Commandant?
I like it. Thank you, Lucia.
Now, it's my turn to give you a gift.
A gift... for me?
Follow me.
Right here, then.
You all seem to know my name. Where did you come from? Froggie has never seen you before, ribbit.
We... are from a remote place. We've heard the story of the Clover Town.
No clues about the golden fireflies found. Try to scan the surroundings.
Anyways, it's just a set of amazing story and performance cards.
Message replacement.
The Engineering Force has always handled square development. Let's get in touch with Karenina and see if she knows anything.
Collect some information yourself while Teddy is investigating. The Commercial District's Golden Daily should have something about the Commercial Square.
I remember Ross is a big fan of the Golden Daily. Let's check out Kuroro Coffee.
Judging from public sources, the Flourish Guild just looks like a normal business organization.
If Teddy's correct, then it's highly possible that the Flourish Guild is what Kurono uses to control the Commercial District.
Let's sync the current situation with Celica now.
Is this... the Flourish Guild's threat list?
I better keep it. It might serve as evidence for exposing the guild later.
Celica's notification mail has arrived at the terminal. I'm ready for the inauguration. I'll contact her later.
The square looks busier after several rounds of construction.
Is that... Lucia?
Commandant, is something wrong?
Akdilek and Ocean Heart are having a dispute at the outer ring. It could disrupt business, so I need to step in and mediate.
Got it. I'll go with you, Commandant.
Commandant, the three suspects have arrived. Let's question each of them about what they were doing at the time.
Lucia, let's split up!
Roger that, Commandant!
So, what did your "expert" have to say?
We need to check three public terminals, pull their log data, and use that to figure out the suspect's general location.
Alright, let's move.
After we finish recording the beacons, we'll have access to updated map info. Then the terminal can guide us to each destination more efficiently.
Sequence Square looks more open and bright after the renovation. What do you think, Commandant?
Releasing the participant list on the day of the event... That's not something you see every day.
Maybe... this is just another marketing tactic? Deliberately piquing consumer curiosity to keep everyone's attention on the event.
I didn't care much about this event at first. But since it has your attention... I'm starting to get curious.
Maybe I'll invite you to join me next time if it's "interesting" enough, [PlayerName].
Commercial Square
Rotational sync rate deviation within normal parameters. Clean Zone is under real-time monitoring—
Shopping and dining paradise. Come leave your mark here!
Globe Landscape Monument Version: Terra-07 Guardian, Coordinates: Commercial Square.
Investment, startups, and diverse business projects are all in full swing, built and run by the Business Commercial Council.
Golden Age Heritage Exhibition—explore the culture and traditions of the past. A visit you won't regret!
Custom cocktails made just for you. Bartender specials at surprise prices. Come try them!
Premium coffee and fruit from the West Coast, the perfect energy boost just for you!
Come to the Kowloong Chamber of Commerce! Enjoy exclusive deals on food, drinks, and home goods!
Welcome to Ocean Heart. Discover the beauty of Atlantic fire opal craftsmanship.
Hey, card shark! Been waiting for you. How about a round?
Arctic relics—handcrafted goods from Arctic Route Union. Guaranteed top quality.
Best services at Inn Elite! The more you buy, the more you get!
Dolly's Bakery—double your luck with cupcakes full of happiness!
Fancy Pizza—high energy, long-lasting fuel for every journey.
CUB trial service is now available. Equipped with Type II Guidance modules. Check the manual for details.
Reading is a portable refuge. Welcome to Soul's Window! Subscribe now for a free humanities edition. Print preview available.
Traffic Notice: Incoming passengers, please detour. This is a dock arrival zone, no entry against flow.
Construction ahead. Non-engineering staff must apply for a temporary pass from the Engineering Force.
Eco-pool with simulated gravity that keeps the water from drifting across the square.
Kuroro Coffee
Orbital Corridor
Welcome to Kuroro Coffee!
Rich flavor, easy moments. Welcome to Kuroro Coffee.
Kuroro Coffee's new latte is out! Surprise launch with prizes. Come give it a try!
The stir stick draws circles in the foam, every bubble like a day of rest compressed.
The Orbital Corridor directory shows shops in detail. Some are marked under renovation—coming soon.
The second-floor map shows a walkway circling Kuroro Coffee, with an observation deck offering eco-tech greenery.
Brought together by dreams, by food, by passion, by joy—we all meet here.
Head downstairs to Kowloong Restaurant—every flavor worth falling in love with.
Kowloong Restaurant welcomes you! Book a table, try dishes, and enjoy great offers!
The Fourth Poken Economic Forum ended with optimism for the household CUB market, though production systems still await feedback.
WGAA collaboration merch—limited restock, selling fast!
Kuroro Fast-Charge—made for small aircraft.
Biocura Pharmacy—Star of Life certified. Official Construct repair center.
The virtual sky glows above, the ground feels inverted. Right now, humanity shines brighter than the stars.
Kowloong cargo has piled up like mountains.
Halevi Repair Station—appliances, smart machines, diagnostics, reliable repairs. It's more than fixing, it's bringing things back to life.
Elevator maintenance blocks the way. You'll need to detour until the Engineering Force reopens it.
Sequence Square
Spectrum calibration 78%. Accurately recreates most Earth flora colors.
Holographic recorders in trial. 24/7 wear rate under 0.03%. Now available for private purchase.
Sequence Square cubic hologram projectors, maintained by the Engineering Force.
Memorial: We watch, we unite. Humanity keeps moving forward. Let this stand as a tribute to human glory.
The Astral Canopy's projection sways in the void. Just standing nearby brings calm.
Atlantic Red Tide system stable. Subtropical cyclones brought early rain. Ground squads, stay ready.
Data Hub Visualization Platform. Report issues directly to the Engineering Force.
Bionic plants spread across, holographic clouds drift above. All recreated with eco-tech.
Norman Mining's polyhedron storage units. Made from stable, solid metal, often used as decor.
Commandant signal detected. Standby mode disengaged. Smart Life Assistant active. You have unread messages...
The workstation can handle daily gear repairs. But power armor? Leave that to the Support Force.
Start your day with coffee and energy.
Ross sent a message. The psychologist appears to be near Commercial Square.
Around Sequence Square, huh... Let's go check it out.
According to the photo the doctor provided, the person up ahead is Rhea.
Better give her some space to calm down first.
Alright, let me snap a picture of the Astral Canopy first in Sequence Square.
Good, the photo came out nice and clear. This should do it.
Next up are drinks. I can go ask Ross at Kuroro Coffee for that.
Here you go. I hope this helps Rhea.
Next, let's check if the doctor is ready.
Everything's ready. Time to find Rhea.
Find time to talk to Ross.
Let's wait around here for Ross for a bit.
Seems like Ross' heart hasn't been where it's supposed to be these days...
What happened in there?
Sounds like a quarrel.
Let's find out.
Those two suspicious guys just went downstairs!
Follow them, don't let them get away, bear.
That bin over there is the one for recycling, bear.
They've responded.
They've sent the locations of other malfunctioning Kuroro units. The first one is near Galaxy Fashion—let's check it out.
...Let's try to resolve this peacefully.
One down. The next malfunctioning Kuroro is at...
Near the lounge? How did it get there?
Things are working smoother than I imagined.
Looks like it needs an ID to open...
Beep beep... Wrong password.
Strange rack... Maybe it's linked to the password.
Need to get across quickly.
Rotating bridge control platform. I can probably use this to make a new path.
The Commercial District is a relatively relaxed area. It's a cozy place for taking some time off.
Wow, the Commercial Square underwent some major renovations. It's very different compared to before.
Manager Ross gave us quite a lot of coffee beans last time. Let's go thank him.
It's late. A rare day off. Better get some rest.
